posts.text:
After The Economist’s interview with Elon Musk, will major media finally reassess how they cover the fascist billionaire?

As its editor-in-chief did the rounds saying she was “not a Musk hater,” he was on X calling her a traitor to the West and suggesting she be murdered. Please, have some dignity.

posts.text:
If you want to understand how the US led rules based order works, here's great example.

When the ICC goes after criminals in non US allied countries, it is a beacon of international law. If pressure gets so high that it has no choice but to go after US allies, it's no longer a useful institution.
